trade.text: Supported reducing trade barriers, reauthorizing the Export-Import Bank, and passing the USMCA to expand international trade.
trade.quote: San Diego’s economy depends on international trade. In order to remain globally competitive, the United States must reduce barriers to its exports

debt.text: Participates in the Bipartisan Fiscal Forum, which advocates bipartisan proposals to address the national debt and rising interest costs.
debt.quote: The Bipartisan Fiscal Forum (BFF) is a group of like-minded congressmembers dedicated to sounding the alarm about our nation's unsustainable debt trajectory and working together to get control of our fiscal future.

housing.text: Says San Diego needs to build more housing and that he is working to incentivize additional development.
housing.quote: We need to build more housing for people of all income levels in a way that’s thoughtfully planned for our communities.

schools.text: Supports investing in teachers and a public education system while expanding education and training opportunities.
schools.quote: Scott is dedicated to investing in our education workforce to support a public education system where students are treated equitably and feel supported.

immigration.text: Said refugees and immigrants should have the opportunity to build better lives in the United States and supported funding for additional special immigrant visas.
immigration.quote: Scott will continue to ensure our minority communities have a voice and that refugees and immigrants have the same opportunity to build a better life in America, just as our ancestors.

guns.text: Called for universal background checks, bans on weapons of war, and restrictions on firearm purchases by suspected terrorists and domestic abusers.
guns.quote: Congress can prevent these tragedies if it implements universal background checks, bans weapons of war, and prohibits suspected terrorists and domestic abusers from purchasing firearms.

abortion.text: Voted for a funding package after House Democrats removed provisions that would have made abortion illegal nationwide and supported protections for servicemembers traveling for reproductive health care.
abortion.quote: House Democrats were successful in removing harmful Republican policies from these bills that attempted to make abortion illegal everywhere

cannabis.text: Voted for the MORE Act to decriminalize marijuana and expunge nonviolent federal marijuana convictions, and has supported federally legalizing cannabis.
cannabis.quote: Rep. Peters voted to pass a historic marijuana reform bill, the bipartisan Marijuana Opportunity Reinvestment and Expungement (MORE) Act to decriminalize marijuana at the federal level and expunge all non-violent federal marijuana criminal offenses from an individual's record.

health.text: Supported funding for Medicaid and a requirement that state Medicaid programs cover medications and services for opioid-use disorder.
health.quote: Requirement that state Medicaid programs cover all forms of medication for the treatment of opioid use disorder, including methadone, counseling services, and behavioral therapy

energy.text: Supported funding that he said would continue efforts to fight climate change and included additional climate and energy resiliency funding.
energy.quote: House Democrats were successful in removing harmful Republican policies from these bills that attempted to make abortion illegal everywhere, slash efforts to fight climate change, and threaten our national security.

voting.text: Said protecting voting access and ensuring that every eligible person can cast a ballot are central commitments.
voting.quote: Securing our democracy against efforts to undermine our elections and ensuring every eligible American can cast their ballot remains one of Scott’s main commitments.

debt.text: Says he will defend Social Security and Medicare from cuts.
debt.quote: Steve Cohen will defend Social Security and Medicare from cuts

housing.text: Says he will expand housing supply to address housing costs.
housing.quote: Steve Cohen will fight for real solutions: expanding housing supply
